```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(agridat)
data("omer.sorghum")
df <- omer.sorghum %>% filter(env == "E3")
```

Model 1 :

$$y_{ij}=\mu_0 + G_i + b_j + \varepsilon_{ij}, \\ \varepsilon_{ij} \sim N(0, \sigma^2_\varepsilon)$$

$$E(\hat{b_j}) = b_j$$

```{r}
model0 <- lm(yield ~ 1 + gen, data = df)

model1 <- lm(yield ~ 1 + gen + rep, data = df)
```

Model 2: 

$$b_j \sim N(0, \sigma^2_b)$$

```{r}
model2 <- lmer(yield ~ 1 + gen + (1|rep), data = df)
```

```{r}
sigma(model1)^2
sigma(model2)^2
```


```{r}
emmeans(model1, ~rep)

emmeans(model1, ~gen, contr = list(c(1, -1, rep(0, 16))))$contrast
emmeans(model2, ~gen, contr = list(c(1, -1, rep(0, 16))))$contrast

emmeans(model2, ~gen)
```

```{r}
as.data.frame(emmeans(model1, ~rep))$emmean - mean(as.data.frame(emmeans(model1, ~rep))$emmean)
```

```{r}
getME(model2, "b")
```
